summary.text: Fabian Doñate is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Senate who has represented District 10 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia, which spells his surname "Donate," says Fabian Doñate was born in Los Angeles, California, and earned a B.S. in public health from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2018 and a master's degree in healthcare administration from the University of Maryland in 2020.

His career experience includes working as a development consultant with the University of Maryland School of Public Health, regional account management coordinator with the American Cancer Society, and health policy research assistant with the Center for Latino Prosperity.
The Clark County Commission appointed him to the Senate on February 2, 2021, following the resignation of Yvanna Cancela, and he was sworn in on February 4, 2021.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Senate Education, Senate Growth and Infrastructure, Senate Health and Human Services (as chair), and Revenue and Economic Development (as vice chair) committees.
